title: Challenges in deep learning-based small organ segmentation: A benchmarking perspective for medical research with limited datasets
mechanism: In low-data benchmarks, bootstrap CIs of the top models overlap and rankings change between ID and OOD and across datasets, so the paper argues for uncertainty-aware evaluation.
adaptation: Our regime matches (478 cells, inactive decided by 3 cells). Require several seeds x several folds per method and report rank intervals.
min_experiment: For house, PF and nnU-Net: seed x fold variance decomposition on OOF and E1. Decision: if the seed SD is > half the method gap, require 5 seeds per method in the protocol.
evidence: R: 10 models on 9 training images plus an OOD set of N=153. Foundation models hold up OOD while classical models fail, and rankings are not stable.
